open_points.text: The body is one JSON-RPC 2.0 message, read only after the size and token checks.
open_points.other_text: The id of every response is the body's id member when the body is one JSON object whose id is a string or an integer, and null otherwise; reading it checks nothing and decides nothing.
open_points.question: Must the body remain unread when the size or token check fails, making the response id null, or may it be parsed to recover the id for every response?
